entries.zh: 培墓——每年一次添土修葺家人坟墓（扫墓培土之俗）
entries.en: to tend and repair the family grave (adding earth), once a year

entries.zh: 翻板——印刷雕版；整备印版，亦指重刻旧板翻印
entries.en: the printing blocks; to set right the plates of the press; to recut plates for a reprint

entries.zh: 三出汤——用同一汤先后三度上桌、各配一样菜（宴席规矩）
entries.en: soup served in three rounds from one broth, with three dishes

entries.zh: 谜——谜语；猜谜
entries.en: riddle; enigma

entries.zh: 猜看出——猜而看出来、看破
entries.en: to guess and make out (discern whether it be right)

entries.zh: 猜中了——猜着、猜中
entries.en: to guess and hit upon it

entries.zh: 猜拳——划拳，猜单双行令之戏
entries.en: the finger-guessing game (morra); guessing even or odd

entries.zh: 猜枚——猜手中所握之物的单双
entries.en: to guess whether the count held in the hand is even or odd

entries.zh: 东猜西猜——一会儿猜这个，一会儿猜那个，乱猜
entries.en: to guess now this, now that; to guess at random

entries.zh: 猜出来了——谜底出来了（猜中）
entries.en: guessed it; the riddle came out

entries.zh: 谨慎细猜——小心试探地猜
entries.en: to guess cautiously, with tact

entries.zh: 约赌——游戏打赌式的猜（以约定分胜负）
entries.en: to wager; to guess in play as a bet

entries.zh: 约拳——划拳猜单双
entries.en: the fist game of guessing even or odd (morra)

entries.zh: 约定——预先讲定、商定
entries.en: to agree upon, stipulate
entries.notes: 西语释义为 adivinar/[acertar]（方括号系原编校正），与汉字“约定”本义（讲定）错位，释义从汉字本义取。

entries.zh: 卜——占卜、卜问
entries.en: to divine by lots

entries.zh: 卜卦——掷卦问卜
entries.en: to divine by casting lots (bu-gua)

entries.zh: 料想——猜而料中（詎）
entries.en: to reckon, surmise rightly
entries.notes: 单字“詎”作“猜中”解非习见，据西语释义与下条“詎料”推定。

entries.zh: 詎料——料想、逆料；今多谓“料想不到”
entries.en: who would have thought; to foresee, reckon beforehand

entries.zh: 占——占卜、占卦
entries.en: to divine

entries.zh: 占卜——占卦问吉凶
entries.en: divination; to divine by lots

entries.zh: 占台官——占星官、司天占验之官（朝廷占卜官）
entries.en: astrologer-official; court diviner or prophet
entries.notes: “占臺官”用字少见于传世文献，西语附注“como dizen que es el Rey”语义含混，释义据“adivino o profeta”与“官”字定为占验之官。

entries.zh: 抽签求签——完籤，把签抽完以问卜
entries.en: to draw divination lots
entries.notes: “完籤”非习见组合，据“籤”与西语“adivinar por suertes”推定为求签问卜。
